summary: All rounding now lives in meterbill/money.py (round_amount, allocate, legacy_cents, fixed); the decimal-context line is removed. Batch worker threads used the default half-even context while other paths used half-up, so I kept both via keyword-only `method` parameters on charge_bands, compute, effective_price, bill_record and batch_line. Existing tests pass, tests/test_money.py is added, and 1227 CLI runs matched the original byte for byte. Quirks kept as they were: batch rounds band charges and eff_price half-even while bill and quote round them half-up, and cash 'whole' prints 0 where a step rule prints -0.00 for small negative totals.
